lines.text: The apostles performed many signs and wonders, and the believers gathered together in Solomon's Colonnade.
The high priest and the Sadducees arrested the apostles, but during the night an angel opened the jail doors.
The captain of the temple guard found the apostles teaching in the temple courts and brought them without force.
A Pharisee named Gamaliel reminded the Council of Theudas and Judas the Galilean, and advised them to leave the apostles alone.
The Council had the apostles flogged and released them, and they left rejoicing and kept teaching daily.
